findings.description: When ANSI stripping applies, the prompt text is passed through .strip(), which removes the trailing space before the input cursor and any leading whitespace from the prompt.
findings.rationale: Trigger: click.prompt() on a non-TTY stream (so should_strip_ansi is true) with a prompt whose suffix is ': '. The prompt text becomes 'Name:' instead of 'Name: ', so the user's typed input is shown directly after the colon. Impact: the prompt output differs from the unstripped path and from the TTY path, with no space before the cursor, a visible regression in piped or captured prompt output.
